For a corporation that has stopped trading but has not been dissolved, and for one with no revenue, no bank activity and no employees in the tax year. The filing obligation still applies.

$300.00 per tax year, plus $39.00 HST, so $339.00 in total per tax year. Each tax year is a separate return and carries the same fee. Six unfiled years are six returns.

A nil T2 does not cover your Ontario annual return, a federal Corporations Canada annual return at $12.00, an Alberta AT1, a Quebec CO-17, or a nil GST/HST or payroll filing. We tell you which of these you still owe.
